title: Mind the Phase: Effective Rank and Representation Health in Legged Locomotion
abstract: arXiv:2609.06958v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become the leading paradigm in legged locomotion, enabling complex behaviors from backflips to parkour through massively parallel simulation. Under PPO's non-stationarity, shallow networks remain the de facto architecture, supported by carefully staged curricula and environments, yet the representations these policies learn stay poorly understood, leaving no training-time signal of how they will behave on hardware. In this work, we empirically study locomotion policies through the effective rank of the policy Jacobian and show that conditioning rank on the gait phase exposes architectural structure that global rank averages away. In particular, we find that standard architectural choices, namely layer normalization and residual connections, allocate roughly two more dimensions of effective rank to swing than to stance, which is fully absent in vanilla MLPs. translated_title: 注意相位：腿式运动中的有效秩与表征健康度
translated_abstract: 强化学习已成为腿式运动领域的主导范式，通过大规模并行仿真实现了从后空翻到跑酷等复杂行为。在PPO的非平稳性条件下，浅层网络仍是事实上的标准架构，并辅以精心设计的课程与环境，然而这些策略所学到的表征仍然鲜为人知，目前没有任何训练时的信号能够预示它们在真实硬件上的表现。在这项工作中，我们通过策略雅可比矩阵的有效秩对运动策略进行了实证研究，并表明将秩条件化于步态相位可以揭示被全局秩平均所掩盖的架构结构。特别地，我们发现标准的架构选择，即层归一化和残差连接，会为摆动相分配比支撑相多出约两个维度的有效秩，而这种现象在普通MLP中完全不存在。基于此，我们提出了一个简单的方案，该方案……
tldr: 该论文通过按步态相位分解策略雅可比矩阵的有效秩，揭示了层归一化和残差连接会使摆动相比支撑相多获得约两个有效秩维度的架构结构，并据此提出了提升腿式运动策略表征健康度的简单方案。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that conditioning the effective rank of the policy Jacobian on gait phase reveals architectural structure hidden by global averages—layer normalization and residual connections allocate roughly two more effective rank dimensions to swing than to stance—and proposes a simple recipe for improving representation health in legged locomotion policies.
